standbyNote: Wi-Fi standby is published as 7.8–8.2 W. The estimate uses the top of that band. Offline standby is published as 7.3–7.8 W.
notModeled: No official per-fan wattage, so fan speed does not change the estimate.
No official hotend-only wattage. Maximum power is applied only while the bed is below its target, which is the case the P2S FAQ ties to the 3–5 minute maximum-power heat-up.
The printing band is the published PLA steady-state figure even when the job is not PLA.
rules: If the bed target is set and the bed is more than the hysteresis below it, use that mains maximum and do not add AMS on top. Otherwise use PLA steady-state while PREPARE, RUNNING, or PAUSE, and standby otherwise, then add AMS 2 Pro drying (80 W), or working (12 W) while a tray change is in progress, or standby (1 W) when an AMS is present. Cap the sum at the mains maximum.
